tip.label: TIP
tip.1: Drag a panel with the mouse to move it.
tip.2: Press the arrow keys to nudge a panel; hold Shift for bigger steps.
tip.3: Press “Write to game slot” to send the layout to the game.
tip.4: After writing a slot, load that preset in the game's Edit UI.
tip.5: Close the game before writing a slot — otherwise it wipes the change.
tip.6: Don't fear writing a slot: a backup is made every time.
tip.7: Backups are in the .backups folder of the library: File → Open library folder.
tip.8: Press H to hide a panel in game.
tip.9: Hold Space and drag to pan the canvas.
tip.10: Press F to see the whole screen again.
tip.11: Put a game screenshot under the layout: View → Background screenshot.
tip.12: Ctrl+click several panels to align them in a row.
tip.13: Type X and Y on the right to place a panel exactly.
tip.14: Right-click a game slot to copy it into the library.
tip.15: Bind a character so the entry remembers its skills: Layout → Character.
tip.16: Q is a quick slot, C is a cooldown slot.
tip.17: Leave a gap under cooldown slots so their captions fit.
tip.18: Name your characters once with “Name…” in the character picker.
tip.19: Turn on the grid to place panels in even steps.
tip.20: Press Ctrl+D to copy an entry before experimenting.
tip.21: Press F1 to see all shortcuts.
tip.22: Get the newest version: Help → Check for updates.
